question:
**Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom.**

Turn over a new leaf
solution:
The correct answer is **'To begin again'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The expression **'turn over a new leaf'** means to begin a new and improved course of behavior. (नया जीवन शुरू करना/ पूरी तरह बदल जाना)

 
 
• Example- She **turned over a new leaf** and began coming to work on time.
 
 
 
• Clearly this is the most appropriate option for the given idiom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The expression **'fresh start'** means to make a new new start or the act of starting over. (एक नई शुरुआत करने या फिर से शुरू करने की क्रिया)

 
 
• Example- You should have a **fresh start** after moving.
